notes.title: New Update - Early access v0.29!
notes.content:
Early access - v0.29

 Edited running animation.
 Added right and left movement. (A and D keys)
 Added right and left movement animations.(A and D keys)
 Edited characters controls.
 Added training.
 Texts are now 3D at Respawn Points and Checkpoints.
 You can no longer see texts behind walls.
 Character no longer jumps extra time.
 Character can no longer jump without an object under them near walls.
 The moving object no longer slips under character (Character and the object moves as one)
 Fixed some bugs at some stages.
 Fixed minor bugs.


Discord: https://discord.gg/nV4q7N8
You can join our discord server to help us support your language!

I continue to develop the game!
Frutgamestudios
